title: Refinished SEKA Spear RDC frame weigh-in
notes: A paint shop stripped a size-S Spear frame to bare carbon and re-coated it with clear primer, reporting 718 g for the frame and 345 g for the fork, 95 g less than its original paint. In a reply the poster confirms the frame is an RDC. This is a modified finish, not a stock weight.

capture.scope: Archived public post; text and replies read locally. No image is republished.
